thread:
ada: quick sync  River13b-int4 onboarding: observed p95 regressions and 2 OOMs during a traffic burst when users requested long completions (>700). Looks linked to prefetch + large max_new_tokens.
noah: any logs?
ada: snippet below from the canary node: 

```
[2026-03-26T11:44:12Z] alloc_error: contiguous_alloc failed 1.95GB required for kv block
[2026-03-26T11:44:12Z] kv_prefetch: pages=44 page_size=64KB total=2.75MB
[2026-03-26T11:44:12Z] batch: inflight=11 max_new_tokens=768
[2026-03-26T11:44:12Z] allocator: largest_free_segment=760MB free_chunks=26
```

ada: interestingly fp16 build handled same traffic fine; quant profile seems to increase fragmentation.
yuki: immediate mitigations we tried in parallel: 1) reduce model default max_new_tokens to 300, 2) switch kv_prefetch to "windowed" mode (prefetch in N-byte windows), 3) soft cap long-gen batch size to 6.
noah: did that change the signal?
yuki: early canary numbers: p95 dropped ~28% and no further OOMs in the first 40m. largest_free_segment median rose from ~820MB -> 1.9GB.
ada: we also added a very small runtime retry: on failed contiguous alloc, trigger a best-effort coalesce pass limited to 8ms then retry once. converted two hard OOMs into successful retries.
noah: CPU cost? ops-bot: compaction_retry metric shows ~3 retries/min during the burst; CPU increase was negligible on canary hosts.
yuki: follow-ups: - add allocator exporters: allocator.largest_free_segment_bytes, allocator.total_free_bytes, allocator.coalesce_attempts. - add an alert for largest_free_segment < 750MB for >30s during canary. - add nightly fuzz test exercising many short-turn dialogues that request long continuations to catch regressions.
ada: long-term: open infra ticket to improve slab coalescing and avoid large contiguous allocation requirements for KV blocks (streaming prefetch + split-kv-layout). Also evaluate quantization layout tweaks (page alignment) to reduce fragmentation.
noah: customer impact: lowering max_new_tokens affects <1% of calls; we have a routing rule to send explicit >512 requests to dedicated-large pool. please add a short customer note and update onboarding doc.
yuki: will prepare the doc and keep the canary overrides for 24h then propose stable rollout if no regressions. thanks all :thumbsup:
